title: Olive's Cottage Vacation Rental
meta_description: Olive's Cottage is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionOLIVE’S COTTAGESeagrove Beach – The Hammocks Community8 Lichen Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 32459Home Highlights:3 bedrooms (see room configurations under “Room Details”)3 bathrooms1,531 sq. ft.Sleeps 8 guestsWalking distance to Seagrove Beach; biking distance to Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton BeachWraparound porch with fans, dining table, and outdoor sofaIndoor fireplaceOutdoor propane grill and showerLaundry room with full-size washer and dryer (separate back entry)3-vehicle drivewayFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb, bikes not included; additional rentals available)Property Description:Escape the ordinary 30A vacation at Olive’s Cottage, a charming farmhouse-style retreat nestled in a gated community surrounded by oaks and magnolias. The large wraparound porch invites you to relax with the sounds of nature, while the interior’s aquamarine, driftwood, and ivory décor creates a serene coastal ambiance.The main living area features a cozy brick fireplace, a banquette dining area, and an oversized sofa perfect for relaxing. The fully equipped kitchen boasts marble countertops, custom cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances. Comfortably sleeping 8 guests, Olive’s Cottage is ideal for one or two families.The Hammocks community offers two pools and a nature trail leading to a dock on Western Lake. A short walk or bike ride will take you to the nearby Seagrove Beach access or the neighboring communities of Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton Beach.Community Amenities:2 community pools (2–3 min walk; not heated)Scenic 395 Beach Access nearbyWestern Lake dock access via nature trailPrivate, gated community on Hwy 395 near 30AParking & Golf Carts:Driveway parking for 3 vehicles (2 front, 1 back); no street or yard parkingStreet-legal golf carts allowed if parked in designated driveway spaceReservation & Policies:NO SMOKINGPets not allowed (service animals only with documentation)Rates exclude taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or in full if within 60 days)5% cancellation fee; full refund of initial payment if canceled >60 days before arrivalOptional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years of age
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Guest Bedroom: King - Bathroom accessible from the bedroom and the hallway
2nd Floor Guest Bedroom: Queen, Bunk Beds (2 Twins)
